sinopsis.es: Una adolescente colombiana en Los Ángeles comienza a desmoronarse ante la amenaza de deportación. Criada para sentirse fuerte, siente crecer una incomodidad, mientras el miedo la aleja de lo que la hacía sentir a salvo. Entre recuerdos de infancia y de un amor seguro, enfrenta la marea que lleva dentro, en un mundo que amenaza con borrarla.
sinopsis.en: A Colombian teenage girl in Los Angeles begins to unravel as the threat of deportation creeps into her world. Though raised to believe herself strong, a quiet unease grows inside her, as fear pulls her away from everything that once felt safe. As she struggles to piece together memories that bleed into the present, fragments of childhood, and fleeting love, she confronts the rhythm of the waves and the tide inside her in a world that threatens to erase her.
